findings.claim: The new exports `finishedKey` and `hasFinished` are not imported anywhere. Only tracks.ts uses them, as the key builder for `hasFinished`/`saveFinished` and as the default reader for `isTrackLocked`. That adds two public helpers to the content module's surface that nothing outside it uses.
findings.evidence: Grep `finishedKey|hasFinished` over /work (excluding node_modules) finds them only in src/content/tracks.ts:34, 42, 44, 53 and 60. game.ts imports only `isTrackLocked`, `nextTrackId` and `saveFinished`, start.stage.ts imports only `TRACKS`, `TRACK_LOCKS` and `isTrackLocked`, and the new tests write the literal key 'racer.finished.hay-loop' instead of calling `finishedKey`.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the `export` keyword from `finishedKey` and `hasFinished` in src/content/tracks.ts so they stay module-private. No other code changes.

checked.how: The report says 'No clones found' for this branch's changed files.

Compared the two. Both wrap localStorage in try/catch, but they use different keys and value semantics (presence flag vs a parsed ms value). Merging them into a shared store wouldn't make the code smaller, so I didn't flag it.
Changed in place, not copied. Its only caller is game.ts:119 (onNextRace), and the explicit-ids path is kept for the existing next-track tests.

refreshBests was renamed and extended, not duplicated. Grep `refreshBests` finds no leftover. select() on an unknown or locked id: pick() returns early because `undefined !== false`, so there's no dead branch.
Both setters go through one showBest helper. The svg markup was moved into the `art` wrapper, not copied, and the old inline svg is gone from the diff.
The phone and .is-desktop rules follow the file's existing pattern of scaling by --desktop-scale. The locked hover/active/focus override is one block, not repeated.
Grep of the POINTS keys found no existing lock or padlock icon, so this is a new glyph, not a duplicate.
Used by start-screen.ts and start.stage.ts. It isn't dead.
The new helper reuses twinPlayerInputs from helpers.ts and doesn't re-implement it. blockStorage is new and only covers this test-only storage swap.

B11 is marked not started. The only in-flight PR, #35 (B13), touches only src/sim pickups and bots, so there's no overlap. B07 best-laps.ts says 'B08/B11 read the same key', and track-card still reads bests via bestLaps.read, so that key isn't re-implemented.
Read tick() at game.ts:192-202. The save fires on the tick car 0 finishes, using the existing `finished` flag and no new state. It doesn't duplicate the best-lap write path.
